docet imago Dei, ad quam homo est conditus.

page.notes: The marginal reference reads "Ro.7.33." in print; the last digits sit raised, so I read it as 23 with doubt, hence [?]. The leading "4" on the last line is a small figure, probably the rest of the reference "Eph. 4.24", and is kept as printed. The catchword "prehensa" is printed at the lower right. The word "latæ" is read from a ligature and is uncertain. No reference marks appear in the text. The printed page number is 631.
